classification.difficultyReason: Select the applicable corresponding, alternate or co-interior rule and state a reason.

content.prompt: Calculate the value of the missing angle and give a reason.

spec.description: Horizontal parallels with rightward chevrons, rising transversal and left-side interior sectors.

answer.worked:
Co-interior angles between parallel lines sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}x+50&=180\\x&=130\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Gently rising parallel lines with rightward chevrons and a steep rising transversal; lower-right obtuse sectors.

answer.worked: $r=124^\circ$ because corresponding angles on parallel lines are equal.

spec.description: Vertical parallels with upward chevrons crossed by a gently rising transversal; left lower-right and right upper-left interior sectors.
spec.mathematics: Alternate interior angles: m = 108. Printed corresponding-angle reason is disputed.

answer.worked: $m=108^\circ$ because alternate angles between parallel lines are equal.
